method: Member source/control-flow review; Base64/gzip/deflate decoding; .NET IL method-body inspection with dnfile/dncil; native Rizin and Capstone disassembly; atomscan and cleave facts before/after. No payloads executed.
path_normalization: Debian extraction initially omitted data/. Listed members were copied byte-for-byte to their requested data/ paths. Mettle data.tar.gz was extracted from the supplied gem and its listed SHA-256 verified.

members.behavior: Gzip/Base64 .NET entry point installs keyboard and clipboard recording; speech-triggered audio, desktop and camera capture are supported.
Architecture-selected native Mimikatz images are mapped reflectively; default logonpasswords execution dumps LSASS credentials and crypto commands bypass private-key export restrictions.
Patches bundled DLL commands, injects into a trusted process and writes an auto-elevation DLL hijack; its batch launcher deletes itself.
Enumerates domain users, reflectively invokes lsadump::dcsync for each selected account and parses returned NTLM credential material.
Network/event/packet triggers call back to an operator, decode returned commands and evaluate PowerShell; repeated callbacks provide remote command polling.
Loads the embedded SweetPotato assembly and invokes its exploit entry; intercepted authenticated tokens are duplicated to launch an operator-selected program with higher authority.
Loads compressed SharpSecDump; its Main path dispatches remote registry hive extraction and SAM/LSA secret decryption into plaintext/hash reports.
Maps an embedded VNC payload in memory for remote desktop control, patches its connection configuration and clears image magic in the reflective loader.
Exploits a suspended-logon handle race using CreateProcessWithLogonW, token duplication and thread impersonation to start a SYSTEM shell.
Starts hidden PowerShell containing a certificate-validation bypass and a DownloadString-to-Invoke-Expression payload cradle.
Includes executable service-binpath abuse and account-creation payload writers, DLL hijack payloads, and stored-password extraction; this is more than an audit-only library.
CredEnumerate returns native credential records; CredentialBlob pointers are unmarshaled and printed with usernames and passwords.
Injects a bundled native DLL into selected processes; its network/TLS hooks record plaintext and apply credential-oriented filters.
Clones or selects SYSTEM Winlogon and injects a DLL calling LsaLogonUser, making a credential logon and impersonated token originate inside Winlogon.
Writes an mscfile shell-open command override, starts auto-elevating Event Viewer and removes the override afterward.
Printer-driver installation loads a supplied or embedded DLL; the embedded DLL creates a local administrator account with a known password.
Uses a raw printer port to write ualapi.dll into System32 and installs a hidden encoded launcher in a registry Run key.
Captures HTTP NTLM challenge responses and relays authentication to SMB/RPC service creation and remote command execution.
Obtains SYSTEM by impersonating a service-connected named-pipe client or by duplicating and assigning a SYSTEM process token.
Loads a bundled SpoolSample assembly; printer RPC notification calls coerce a remote host to authenticate to the selected capture host.
Steals an LSASS token, derives the SAM boot key and decrypts account hashes using the corresponding RC4/AES and RID-derived DES routines.
Reads local or remote application sessions and saved secrets, including WinSCP decryption and FileZilla password decoding; remote acquisition uses WMI and temporary registry storage.
Loads SharpChromium; browser SQLite queries, DPAPI-unwrapped state keys and blob decryption recover saved logins and cookies, alongside history.
Changes an account RID in the SAM F value after obtaining SYSTEM authority, allowing the selected account to assume another account identity.
Sets the exefile runas IsolatedCommand override, invokes sdclt /kickoffelev and cleans up the override.
Sets ms-settings shell-open command and DelegateExecute values, starts fodhelper and removes the hijack afterward.
Creates and starts a temporary remote service for operator commands or an uploaded executable; optional output retrieval and cleanup use Admin$ temporary files.
Overrides the per-user windir environment value with a hidden launcher and triggers the elevated SilentCleanup task before removing the override.
Invokes SharpLoginPrompt from an embedded assembly; native credential dialogs are repeated until validation succeeds while plaintext passwords are printed to captured stdout.
Polls GetAsyncKeyState, translates keys and records them with foreground-window and timestamp attribution.
POSTs attacker-selected Groovy ProcessBuilder commands to the Jenkins script console and extracts the returned command result.
Abuses JBoss JMX MainDeployer through a HEAD request to deploy a remote WAR, then requests its JSP to trigger execution.
Poisons NBNS/WPAD resolution, reflects captured NTLM authentication to loopback SMB and executes privileged service commands.
Builds concealed PowerShell activation through profile changes and permanent WMI event subscriptions, with additional task/Run-key persistence options.
Impersonates SYSTEM and decrypts local SAM password hashes using boot-key-derived AES/DES operations.
Constructs SMB/NTLM authentication and SCM RPC messages to execute commands through a temporary remote service, including supplied-hash authentication.
Searches SYSVOL Group Policy Preference XML, extracts cpassword values and decrypts them with the published AES key into account/password records.
Enumerates directory accounts and performs repeated LDAP credential binds with candidate passwords, respecting lockout observation windows and recording successful credentials.
Reads Chromium SQLite login/history stores, decrypts password_value blobs with DPAPI and stages plaintext login records into an output file.
Displays application-disguised credential prompts and notifications, validates and repeats requests, then returns captured plaintext credentials.
Runs LLMNR/mDNS/NBNS spoofers and HTTP/SMB challenge-response handling to capture and queue NetNTLM credential material.
Duplicates an elevated process token, manipulates its integrity/restrictions, impersonates it and launches PowerShell through the resulting elevation-control bypass.
Loads an embedded ETW USB keyboard collector and consumes its key-event queue with foreground-window/timestamp attribution.
Enumerates other process/thread tokens, duplicates selected credentials and impersonates them or starts a child using the stolen token without its password.
Writes an MSBuild inline CodeTaskFactory project that decodes commands into a PowerShell runspace; remote mode stages it through admin shares and executes it using WMI.

members.note: Invoke-MS16135: require bitmap corruption and kernel lookup
members.behavior: Uses crafted window/focus operations and bitmap backing-pointer corruption for kernel reads/writes, then copies a SYSTEM token into a spawned process.
Loads Firefox NSS and uses PK11SDR_Decrypt on stored login fields, returning and staging plaintext usernames/passwords in a file.
Recursively locates McAfee SiteList credential XML, reverses its XOR/static-key 3DES protection and returns decrypted account records.
Parses encrypted operator task packets, executes PowerShell/shell jobs and sends results; file tasking reads and transmits base64 file chunks.
IronPython task agent compiles and executes received job code and transfers file chunks through its packet handler; imported helpers supply transport integration.
Python task agent compiles/executes operator code, launches shell tasks and returns results; file-tasking reads and transfers file chunks.
Native stager template downloads an HTTP byte buffer, optionally disables HTTPS certificate checks, copies it into RWX memory and executes it via CreateFiber/SwitchToFiber.

members.note: Mimikatz test payload: correct memory/API evidence
members.behavior: The test-tree member contains functional native Mimikatz images and the same reflective credential-dumping/export-bypass execution paths; its test location does not make the payload inert.
Classic ASP reads .CMD from Request.Form, runs cmd.exe /c through WScript.Shell, returns temporary-file command output and deletes that file.
PHP request handlers execute shell commands, read arbitrary files, browse directories, upload files and execute supplied SQL; the page has no authentication gate.
Perl CGI reads QUERY_STRING, decodes command characters, passes that value to backtick shell execution and prints the resulting lines into the HTTP response.

Ruby gem contains deployable multi-platform Mettle implants and sniffing extensions. Native TLV dispatch registers process execution/file/channel handlers; Ruby support code reads and configures those binaries.
Nested Mettle payload archive contains the same functional native implants and extensions, including operator TLV-driven command execution and network control transports.
